messages:
Jules (Marketing): Quick decision needed  propose we run 'Inference runbook: benchmarks that actually influence procurement' as the next webinar. It's compact and buyer-focused. Approve?
Ravi (Product): Approve. I can cover the problem framing + 1-slide cost vs latency.
Marta (Content): I'll draft a 25-30s blurb for the landing page and a longer 90s speaker brief. Also 3 prompt examples for the demo.
Owen (Ads): Promo timeline suggestion: 10-day funnel: announce (10d), benchmark highlight (6d), reminder (2d), last chance (12h). Paid social starting at 6d.
Jules (Marketing): Rehearsal windows: Tue 8:45 PT tech check, Thu 09:00 PT dress. Can everyone make one of these?
Ravi (Product): I'll be on both.
Marta (Content): Thu dress only for me but I'll join the recording run earlier in week.
Owen (Ads): Fine with tech check. Thu I'll be the last 20min.
WebinarBot: Event placeholder created: "Inference runbook"  Tech check Tue 2024-05-14 08:45 PT, Dress Thu 2024-05-16 09:00 PT. Calendar invites sent.
Jules (Marketing): Draft run-of-show (compact):
00:00-00:30  intro + goal (Jules)
00:30-03:30  buyer pain & procurement triggers (Ravi)
03:30-09:30  benchmark methodology + demo setup (Marta)
09:30-14:00  live compare (Ravi demo, 60s live calls + fallback)
14:00-16:00  checklist + operational playbook (Marta)
16:00-20:00  CTA + next steps (Jules)
20:00-30:00  Q&A (moderated)
Jules (Marketing): Demo rules: 1) Live calls capped at 60s, 2) Fallback image hosted at CDN, 3) Precomputed numbers slide ready, 4) Host will cut to fallback if timeout.
Ravi (Product): I'll upload precomputed CSV + screenshots. Also will provide a simplified chart: $/1k tokens vs median latency.
Marta (Content): Landing copy draft: "Practical inference runbook: real benchmarks, production controls, and the checklist teams use to reduce unit cost without regressing latency." Add attendee callout?
Jules (Marketing): Add: "For platform, SRE, and product infra teams."
Owen (Ads): Registration form fields: Name, Email, Company, Role (dropdown), Main inference pain (short), Interested in a follow-up demo? (yes/no), UTM. Will map role to SDR routing.
Marta (Content): Uploaded abstracts + speaker bullets to Drive: https://drive.google.com/fake/link-runbook (v1).
Jules (Marketing): Action items: Marta finish abstracts EOD tomorrow; Ravi upload demo assets; Owen queue promo copy once abstracts final; Jules send dress invites and confirm recording node. Reply here when done.
Ravi (Product): Demo assets uploaded.
Owen (Ads): Promo copy queued.
Marta (Content): Abstracts final and speaker bullets uploaded.
Jules (Marketing): All good. I'll circulate final deck link by EOD and lock the registration page. Closing thread unless blockers. :rocket:
